类 ProgressGroup

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressGroup
所有已实现的接口:
AutoCloseable
public final class ProgressGroup extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Several progress bars rendered together, one per line.

Every line carries its own [index/count] prefix, e.g.

[1/3] kernel.tar.gz    [==========>        ] 55.00%
[2/3] modules.tar.gz   [=====>             ] 25.00%
[3/3] docs.tar.gz      [================== ] 98.00%

Bars normally advance from different threads; all mutation is synchronized and only one refresh thread writes to the sink.
